species: To thoroughly analyze the performance of different label-free quantification approaches, we generated a gold standard spike-in sample set (GS) consisting of C2C12 cell lysate as constant background and 13 non-mouse proteins each in five different concentrations (study design see Fig. 1).
tissue: Frozen C2C12 cells were warmed up within a water bath (37 °C) and taken into culture in a 58 cm2 Petri dish (Sarstedt, Nümbrecht, Germany) within 10 ml DMEM (Gibco®, Thermo Fisher) standard medium containing 15% (v/v) FCS (Gibco®), 2% (v/v) sodium pyruvate (Biochrom, Berlin, Germany), 1% (v/v) non-essential amino acids (Biochrom) and 1% (v/v) penicillin/streptomycin (Pan Biotech, Aidenbach, Germany).
cell_type: The GS consisted of five different samples that contained the same amount of C2C12 lysate but varying concentrations of each spike-in protein.
